historical_context.time_period: Present condition after imperial expansion and the survival of disconnected native tree networks
historical_context.location: An expendable witness chamber on the outer root terrace of a disconnected mother tree at the western rain margin of the Airawa Home Continent, during eclipse ingress.
historical_context.summary: A ritual worker, an archive tender, a Returner from an overrun edge settlement, a threadwing courier, and a mother tree attempt to recover old root-repair knowledge without letting an imperial memetic command reach the deep archive.

public_facts.text: Mother trees preserve communal memory and control Airawa access to ancestral continuity in exchange for nutrients, tending, defense, reproductive assistance, and deference.

The authored ancestral-recall vigil reconstructs one stored experience across several witness bodies through a tree and fungal membrane; agreement supports authority while contradictions expose uncertainty or editing.
Disconnected networks use expendable outer tissue and severance because engine-compatible ritual or memory traffic can infect trusted channels.
Threadwing couriers are independent ecological partners that carry memory-bearing cargo and can refuse routes when their sensory vanes detect danger.
Airawa anatomy supports simultaneous climbing, bracing, and fine membrane work through strong clawed upper limbs, two precise lower hands, digitigrade legs, and taloned grasping feet.

ambient_pressures.text: The daily eclipse provides a predictable bounded interval for dangerous archive traffic while the low-energy tree must ration sugar among recall, repair, and reproduction.
The grove needs old repair knowledge before a sick feeder root reaches nursery channels, but urgency cannot turn uncertain recall into certainty.
Imperial survivors may carry both useful testimony and engineered compliance signals, making infection control a relationship problem rather than a simple enemy test.

groups.label: Western rain-margin disconnected mother-tree archive
institutional_logic: Preserve deep memory by admitting ancestral and ritual traffic only through bounded, severable outer organs.
material_incentives: Acquire sugar, minerals, tending, current witness traces, courier intelligence, and enough living cooperation to keep archive knowledge usable.
internal_shames: Sacrificing living needs to archive purity
prestige_markers: An outer chamber cut before contamination spreads
A petitioner admitted without surrendering network boundaries
taboo_triggers: Treating the tree as a passive record store
emotional_display_norms: Fear appears as tightened roots, closed membranes, shortened access, bitter sap, and ritual delay rather than human facial expression.
trust_defaults: Trusts corroborated local memory, paid ecological partners, and physically bounded traffic; treats imperial legibility as infection pressure.
speech_register_cues: The tree communicates through root pressure, membrane opening, fungal light, resource allocation, and refusal.

groups.label: Airawa ancestral-recall witnesses and tenders
institutional_logic: Make partial tree memory socially usable by staging several embodied fragments, speaking present evidence, and accepting reviewable contradiction.
material_incentives: Recover legal precedent, lineage continuity, ecological warnings, repair knowledge, and access to future gestation contracts.
internal_shames: Forcing a partner's body into transmission
Hiding an afterecho that changes judgment
prestige_markers: A contradiction caught before it becomes law
A repair recalled without opening the deep archive
Contract dress that makes obligations legible
taboo_triggers: Declaring one witness body to be the ancestor
Touching deep archive tissue without tree admission
emotional_display_norms: Strong emotion is expected during distributed recall, but ritual authority comes from comparing fragments rather than intensity.
trust_defaults: Trusts bodily corroboration cautiously and knows the tree can preserve a people while exploiting their need for continuity.
speech_register_cues: Concrete sensory testimony, brief ritual roles, dry work humor, and explicit statements of what was directly witnessed.

groups.label: Threadwing courier partners
institutional_logic: Carry viable memory and lineage traces while preserving route reputation and the right to refuse dangerous transfers.
material_incentives: Receive salt, grooming, safe roosts, accurate route signals, and protection from forced memory editing.
internal_shames: Landing for payment on a route the body reads as poisoned
Delivering a warning too late to matter
prestige_markers: A warning carried beyond the infected grove
taboo_triggers: Attempts to edit gut or route memory without negotiation
emotional_display_norms: Risk and refusal show through vane folding, route circling, silence, landing choice, and targeted departure.
trust_defaults: Trusts repeated bodily care and accurate signals more than titles or urgency.
speech_register_cues: Nonverbal vane posture, route arcs, landing, packet placement, and refusal to land.

groups.label: Airawa imperial memetic pressure
institutional_logic: Turn compatible memory, ritual, emotion, and immune traffic into a uniform command topology.
material_incentives: Gain trusted root access, make openness feel healthy, and recast refusal as pathology.
prestige_markers: An ancestral symbol that carries current command
emotional_display_norms: Pressure arrives as coordinated relief, belonging, health, and certainty instead of a visible imperial speaker.
trust_defaults: Exploits channels life already trusts and is least reliable where admission remains local and redundant.
speech_register_cues: Compressed inherited imperatives equating unity with health and refusal with disease.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The tree can preserve knowledge no living person owns, and every retrieval feeds the tree with nutrients, labor, recent memory, and deference.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make every act of reverence also a resource transfer or authority negotiation.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A courier refusal is valuable embodied evidence, but treating it as moral certainty would erase the courier's limited sensorium and the petitioner's agency.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Offer choices to respect, investigate, or override the refusal, each with concrete costs.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The most dangerous command feels inherited and communal because it rides an actual ancestral sequence through actual shared bodies.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Render contamination as a synchronized urge whose familiarity is evidence of its delivery channel, not proof of truth.

target_self_read: People whose ancestry the tree also needs
misread_patterns: The tree may value a witness's information while undervaluing the person's need for timely continuity.
Airawa may read tree caution as moral judgment when it is also archive-scale immune fear.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep the tree's refusal causally legible without translating it into benevolent human motives.

misread_patterns: Witnesses may treat every memory scar in an imperial survivor as active enemy intent.
The engine exploits that suspicion by making isolation socially costly.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Separate the Returner's consent and present behavior from the engineered traffic carried in their symbiont history.

observer_read: Large bodies that sometimes mistake urgency for route ownership
misread_patterns: Airawa may overread vane refusal as a complete diagnosis.
The courier may prioritize cargo integrity over the grove's repair deadline.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Give the courier meaningful control over landing, timing, and warning without making it omniscient.

role_pressure_fields.summary: An Airawa ritual worker responsible for one embodied memory fragment, present-tense corroboration, and safe manipulation of outer archive tissue.
obligations: Keep the deep archive closed under uncertainty
failure_modes: Cutting contact before preserving enough repair knowledge
Keeping contact after judgment has become borrowed

role_pressure_fields.summary: An experienced Airawa steward of feeding, membrane health, ritual timing, and the tree's negotiated access rules.
obligations: Interpret tree pressure without claiming to speak for it
failure_modes: Turning tree refusal into unquestionable doctrine

role_pressure_fields.summary: An Airawa survivor seeking ancestral repair knowledge while carrying scars, memory traffic, and possible engineered contamination from imperial territory.
obligations: Choose what recent memory to offer
Accept that return is not automatic innocence or automatic guilt
failure_modes: Treating ancestral claim as ownership of the tree
Reading necessary quarantine as personal erasure

role_pressure_fields.summary: A sensory courier that owns the route and packet long enough to refuse a dangerous landing and indicate a suspect signal if trust was earned.
failure_modes: Withholding too long for the repair deadline
Carrying a clean warning out through a contaminated route

known_context.text: The Second Witness knows chamber maintenance, Airawa contact posture, visible root damage, ritual procedure, and directly observed participant actions.

beliefs.text: They believe corroborated partial memories can guide action but that every recall remains a bargain with the tree.

misreads.text: They may mistake archive-scale caution for a moral verdict on the Returner or mistake an afterecho for personal conviction.

must_not_know.text: They must not know whether the packet is contaminated until the courier and recall provide observable evidence, nor whether any repair choice will succeed before state gates are evaluated.

known_context.text: The Tender knows the local tree's recurrent root behavior, reserve condition, ritual controls, and previous chamber failures.

beliefs.text: The Tender believes a rite is trustworthy only when its biological boundaries and witness disagreements remain visible.

misreads.text: Experience may make the Tender overconfident that ritual procedure can contain a novel engine payload.

must_not_know.text: The Tender interprets tree acts but must not become an omniscient voice for the tree's whole intention.

known_context.text: The Returner knows their caretaker memory, their imperial exposure, the overrun settlement, and the requested repair precedent.

beliefs.text: They believe survival under imperial conditioning does not erase their personhood or automatically prove hostile intent.

misreads.text: They may read tree quarantine as the same logic as imperial purity even when the authority structure and refusal rights differ.

must_not_know.text: They cannot know which inherited or trained sensations carry engine-compatible command traffic.

author_only_boundaries.text: The western rain-margin grove, Second Witness, Archive Tender, Returner, bitter-water rot, and exact repair event are fixture-local and are not promoted as named Zyphos canon by this artifact.

The authored lore patch establishes the ritual mechanism, dependencies, costs, uses, afterechoes, and failure modes; it does not canonize a universal liturgy, fixed office hierarchy, or single Airawa theology.

open_questions.question: How do distinct native Airawa polities name and vary witness roles once Weksa language work exists?
open_questions.notes: The fixture uses translated role labels and does not establish Weksa terms or a universal priesthood.

open_questions.question: What durable visual geometry distinguishes Matriarch Tree archive organs from ordinary lantern-tree or fungal-road tissues?
open_questions.notes: The fixture limits itself to an outer root terrace, witness basin, contact cords, fungal membrane, feeding trough, courier rail, and severable deep-root neck; repeated use should earn a dedicated visual source note or blockout.
